meta.title: Beat Encoder Utilities — Your DJ library, mastered
meta.description: Beat Encoder Utilities — the desktop toolkit for DJ libraries. Organize, grade, fix and level your tracks, all locally.

hero.kicker: FOR DJS WHO TAKE THEIR LIBRARY SERIOUSLY — MAC & WINDOWS

hero.subtitleB: One app puts it all right — so you walk into every set backed by a library you trust.
hero.trust1: Your music never leaves your computer

tools.subtitle: Tap a tool and see what it does for you. Organize once, and everything else — grades, tags, levels — is already taken care of.

items.description: That downloads folder you've been avoiding? Drop it in, see exactly how your library will look, then watch thousands of tracks fall perfectly into place.

See the full plan before anything moves

items.name: Spectrum & Quality
items.tagline: Know every track before the crowd does.
items.description: Ever dropped a track that sounded thin on a big system? Never again. Every track earns one of five verdicts — from Genuine Lossless Master all the way down to Fake Transcode.
bullets: One glance tells you if a track truly delivers
Fake transcodes exposed — the file extension can't fool it
Find any track in seconds by artist, genre or quality

items.name: Tag Fixer
items.description: Missing names, blank titles, wrong years — fixed. Beat Encoder suggests the right details for every track, you glance, approve, and your library finally makes sense.
bullets: Smart suggestions for every missing detail
You approve each fix — nothing changes behind your back
Your files stay exactly where they are

items.name: Volume Normalizer
items.description: No more riding the gain knob mid-set. Pick a target and every track lands there — loud and proud for the club, spot-on for streaming, gentle for the warm-up.
bullets: DJ Master: tuned loud and proud for club systems
Conservative: great for classics and acoustic settings
Two ways to apply: tag-only (audio untouched) or re-encode

items.name: Rekordbox & Playlists
items.description: Your cleaned, graded, leveled library — ready for the booth. Rekordbox and playlist magic is on its way, and your library will be ready the day it lands.
bullets: Built for the way DJs actually prepare
Get the app now and be first in line

spectrum.title: A weak track in a premium costume has nowhere to hide.
spectrum.subtitle: A file can claim to be premium and still sound like a cheap rip — the label proves nothing. Beat Encoder actually listens, then tells you in plain English what each track is really worth. No vibes, just evidence.

grading.subtitle: No black box, no vague promises. Every track gets one of these verdicts — here's what each one means for your set.

rows.meaning: The real deal — rich, full sound exactly as promised
Delivers everything the file claims to be
An honest file with a full-spectrum sound — labeled with its true bitrate
Dressed as premium, but the sound doesn't back it up
A cheap file in an expensive costume

cards.title: Clipping into the red doesn't get a free pass
cards.body: Tracks clipping into the red get flagged and marked down — loud only counts when it's clean.

cards.title: Top marks are earned
cards.body: The HQ badge is reserved for the best of the best. Good, Regular and Low follow below — one glance, instant decision.

cards.title: Loud never fakes quality
cards.body: Being loud doesn't make a track good. Loudness is shown to help you level your set — it never inflates a verdict.

grading.footnote: And when a track is missing its BPM or key, Beat Encoder takes an educated guess from the music itself — clearly labelled as an estimate, never presented as fact. Your tagged details always win.

workflow.subtitle: Your library took years to build. Beat Encoder treats it that way.

steps.title: Drop in your library
steps.body: Point Beat Encoder at the music you already have. In moments, every track is found, graded and ready to explore — no account, no uploads, no fuss.

steps.title: Preview. Approve. Done.
steps.body: Nothing ever happens behind your back. See exactly what will change, tweak anything you like, and only press go when it looks perfect.

steps.title: Changed your mind? Undo it.
steps.body: Try a bold new structure, rename with confidence, experiment freely. If you don't love it, one click takes you right back.

closing.body: Open it and your library is just… there. Fast, gorgeous, and entirely yours — your music never leaves your computer, and there's no account to create. Download, drop in your tracks, and feel the difference in the first minute.

specs.v: Light, dark — or match your system

closing.dlBody: Free, and ready when you are. Download it, drop in your library, and watch the mess turn into a collection you're proud to play from.
